```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03", "08b"),
  funs = "report_format",
  packages = c("here", "dplyr", "knitr", "kableExtra", "scales", "dampack",
               "flexsurv", "survival"),
  set_theme = FALSE,
  quiet_sources = TRUE
)
```

```{r display-table}
detail_df <- enriched_comparison %>%
  transmute(
    Biomarker,
    Enr_Cost = format_eur(Enr_Cost),
    Enr_Effect = sprintf("%.3f", Enr_Effect),
    Enr_Ctrl_Cost = format_eur(Enr_Ctrl_Cost),
    Enr_Ctrl_Effect = sprintf("%.3f", Enr_Ctrl_Effect),
    Enr_ICER = format_icer(Enr_ICER, Enr_Status)
  )

kable(
  detail_df,
  caption = "Table 6: Biomarker-enriched population results",
  format = "html",
  col.names = c("Biomarker", "Experimental Cost", "Experimental QALYs",
                "Control Cost", "Control QALYs", "ICER"),
  align = c("l", rep("r", 5))
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Enriched analysis restricts both arms to biomarker-positive patients.",
      "Experimental arm: FLOX + nivolumab. Control arm: FLOX only.",
      "Costs and QALYs discounted at 4% per year."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(enriched_comparison, file = here("tables", "table_6.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Table 6 has been saved to `tables/table_6.csv`.
